newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Louisiana Land downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Louisiana Land downgraded.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Wednesday it downgraded Louisiana Land and Exploration Co to neutral based on the company's disappointing overall reserve level.

-- Rodman said the company ended 1996 with reserves a disappointing 3.4 percent higher than levels one year ago. Louisiana Land's reserve growth has averaged just two percent annually over the last three years, Rodman said.
-- A line review of the company's 1996 reserve replacement data was not as positive as originally thought, Rodman said.
-- Louisiana Land is an oil exploration and processing company. Its shares were trading down 1/8 Wednesday at 54-1/4.
